steps.title: Set it up in a spreadsheet
steps.one: Open a spreadsheet, then Extensions, then Apps Script.
steps.two: Download the six files above. In Project Settings show the appsscript.json file, and paste appsscript.json and Code.gs over the ones in the editor.
steps.three: Add three HTML files named Dialog, Settings and Help and paste the downloaded files into them.
steps.four: Save and reload the spreadsheet. A CRM menu appears. Allow the three permissions Google asks for.
steps.five: Choose CRM, then Settings, paste your key and select Save and check.
steps.six: Row 1 of your sheet holds the column names. Then use Pull contacts, Push contacts or Sync products from the CRM menu.

columns.title: Columns the add-on reads
columns.contactsHint: email or phone is required. A column named attr:city fills the custom property city. A blank cell never clears a stored value.
columns.productsHint: name and price are required. Products are matched by SKU, then by name. A blank stock means unlimited.
